sentences.text:
By way of present application, the petitioner/applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Fir
No.374/2023 registered under Sections 419/420/467/468/471/120B Ipc at P.S. Ghazipur, Delhi.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant's name has figured only in the
disclosure statement and no other material has been collected by the concerned I.O.
3.
Though a status report was handed over in Court and the same was directed to be placed on record, the Registry has not attached the same with the case file.
Learned APP for the State submits that a fresh status report would be filed in the Registry before the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/07/2024 at 20:57:56 5.
In the meantime, subject to the applicant joining investigation, no coercive steps be taken against him.
